title: C-zero stability of visible length spectral values within primitive flat knot types on closed Riemannian surfaces
difficulty: A small C-zero metric perturbation controls loop lengths and subloop areas but does not control the curve-shortening vector field in the stronger topology normally used for continuation. The authors construct a new two-parameter interleaving inside the fixed primitive knot type, selecting six length levels and five exit thresholds around a visible spectral gap. Their complete diagram preserves the obstruction to a homotopy equivalence for the perturbed metric without assuming isolated or non-degenerate geodesics.
